name: push-decision
title: Push a decision to a date
description: Defers the handoff to that date with your reason, so it comes back on its own.
say: Push the vendor decision to Friday.

inputs.name: handoff
inputs.prompt: Which handoff? Give its path in the vault, like Projects/website/handoff/vendor.md

inputs.name: until
inputs.prompt: Push it to which date? (YYYY-MM-DD, or tomorrow)

steps.title: Defer the handoff to that date
